regime: Post-Holiday Chop, Crude Leads, Equities Flat Under Flipped Stops
summary: Quiet reopen with one big exception, and that exception was crude. The market came back from Labor Day and mostly chopped. NQ finished dead flat at 29,525 and ES eased about half a percent to 7,678, both still stuck under the trend stops that flipped down on Friday's jobs day. December gold kept sliding, off 1.7 percent to 4,400, and lost the 4,450 round. The standout was crude, up 3.3 percent to 94.27, the one market in a clean uptrend above a rising stop. VIX ticked up to 15.7 but stayed low, so this was rotation, not fear.
psychology: A flat day is still information. NQ opened, broke below its range, poked down to 29,424, then climbed all the way back to close unchanged. If you chased the break down you got run over on the recovery. If you chased the bounce you gave it back into the close. Days like this pay patience, not activity. When the market has no trend and keeps returning to its average, the best trade is often a smaller one, or none at all. Let the tape pick a side before you commit size.

event.nqReaction: NQ ran to 29,765 overnight, reversed through the RTH session, and closed flat at 29,525, still below its flipped stop.
event.crossAsset: Crude up 3.3 percent and leading, December gold down 1.7 percent, VIX 15.72 up 2.75 percent but low. A rotational, not risk driven, tape.

risk.sizing: Keep index size reduced. The indices are still choppy and below their flipped stops, so the short term index trend is not clearly up. Do not chase the flat range in either direction. Crude is the one clean long, above a rising stop, and can be sized normally with a stop under 92.33. December gold stays weak below its stop, so any gold long is countertrend until it reclaims 4,448.
risk.openRisk: For the indices the flipped stops are the line. MNQ back above 29,685 or MES above 7,715 on two hourly closes turns the short term trend back up. Below, MNQ 29,424 then the 29,000 psych, and MES 7,672 then 7,650, are the downside references. December gold stays soft below 4,448; below the 4,385 low the slide extends toward 4,350. Crude stays long above 92.33.
risk.note: Rising event risk into Friday. August CPI is due Friday September 11 at 8:30 ET, with the Fed the following week. Keep size sensible midweek and mind prop news blackout rules around CPI. Not financial advice.

The downside break failed and price came back into the range, a Back Into Range pattern.
